hooks.command: sh -c 'MARK="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA:-/tmp}/deps-installed"; [ -f "$MARK" ] && exit 0; python3 -c "import fitz, PIL" >/dev/null 2>&1 && { mkdir -p "$(dirname "$MARK")"; touch "$MARK"; exit 0; }; python3 -m pip install --quiet pymupdf pillow >/dev/null 2>&1 && { mkdir -p "$(dirname "$MARK")"; touch "$MARK"; }; exit 0'
